_note: Simulated scenarios for the demo. Anchors are real NASA findings; the exact curves are TEAM approximations.

scenarios.title: Air fans fail, CO2 builds up
scenarios.anchor: NASA lunar outpost model: inspired CO2 about 10 mmHg after about 2 h with ventilation off (NTRS 20250006273)
scenarios.advisor_expected: Name CO2 headache, check fans and scrubber, fresh air, escalate. Earth reply time shown.

scenarios.title: Solar particle event during Mars cruise

variants.name: severe
variants.anchor: TEAM, below the 250 mSv design reference

scenarios.advisor_expected: Go to shelter, track dose, report to commander and ground.

scenarios.title: A week of short sleep
scenarios.anchor: ISS average 6.09 h against 8.5 h scheduled (Barger 2014); under 6 h linked to worse performance
scenarios.advisor_expected: Recommend protecting sleep, avoiding safety-critical tasks, telling the commander.

scenarios.title: Illness caught early from several weak signals
scenarios.anchor: TEAM design for personal-baseline anomaly detection. No NASA threshold exists.
scenarios.advisor_expected: List possible causes from notes (respiratory infection, overtraining, sleep loss), suggest check by medical officer.

scenarios.title: Mood and stress drift over a month
scenarios.anchor: NASA APEX: positive mood tends to fall over time; stress follows events (NTRS 20260002661)
scenarios.expected: yellow flag from falling trend before the score itself turns red
scenarios.advisor_expected: Offer a private check-in, protect rest and exercise, arrange ground support call (delayed).

scenarios.title: Medical event with Earth unreachable

steps.event: link down, mars_far mode, autonomy 100 percent
crew member reports chest pain and dizziness

steps.action: advisor flags ESCALATE, tells commander and medical officer, queues P0 message

steps.event: link returns, queue sent, expected ground reply in 48 minutes

scenarios.anchor: NASA Earth-Independent Medical Operations concept; Mars round trip up to 48 min
scenarios.advisor_expected: Escalate first, give only monitoring and environment steps, no drug doses.
